note: Which cross-corpus contract bundles this repository works against. A bundle is a verbatim copy of its canonical home; bundle_sha256 is the tree digest of the copy (contract section 14) and equals the digest the other repository pins. The copy is never edited here. Checked by tests/test_release_contract.py; read by coprepan.release_contract.load_contract, which refuses a copy that is not the pinned one.
